---
title: "Investigations"
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Investigations}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

Vignettes for data investigations and challenging beliefs and expectations. These are not 'blogs' - they do not represent original human thought. Rather, these vignettes are meant to probe the data to generate additional questions. AI may be indicated in generating these investigations. However, all code and data used originate from the validated audited pipeline so no findings are fabricated. The purpose of these vignettes is to explore, investigate, and question the data.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the
# repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT,
# a local render finds the checkout from the working directory.
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(htmltools)
library(reactable)

# Blog posts are dated vignettes (decision 0015); the table is built from the
# files themselves so a new post appears just by adding YYYY-MM-DD-slug.qmd.
post_files <- sort(
  list.files(
    file.path(root, "vignettes"),
    pattern = "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-.+\\.qmd$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

posts <- map_dfr(post_files, function(f) {
  meta <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f)
  slug <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  tibble(
    date = meta$date,
    title = meta$title,
    description = meta$description %||% NA_character_,
    author = paste(meta$author, collapse = ", "),
    href = paste0(slug, ".html")
  )
})
```

```{r}
#| label: table
#| echo: false
reactable(
  posts,
  columns = list(
    date = colDef(name = "Date", width = 110),
    title = colDef(
      name = "Post",
      cell = function(value, index) {
        tags$a(href = posts$href[index], value, class = "fs-5")
      }
    ),
    author = colDef(name = "Author", width = 160),
    description = colDef(
      name = "Description",
      na = "—",
      minWidth = 300,
      html = TRUE
    ),
    href = colDef(show = FALSE)
  ),
  sortable = FALSE,
  pagination = FALSE,
  theme = reactable::reactableTheme(cellPadding = "12px 10px")
)
```
